name: sphior
description: Security tooling from SPHIOR — deterministic scanning and audit evidence.

plugins.name: sphior-code
plugins.description: SPHIOR CODE — deterministic security scanning (secrets, CWE patterns, taint analysis) with skills that fix findings, triage false positives, set up CI and gate releases. Runs locally through the SPHIOR CODE CLI or MCP server, no account needed.

plugins.name: sphior-code-guard
plugins.description: Scans every file your agent writes or edits with SPHIOR CODE's deterministic rules (secrets, CWE patterns, taint flows) and hands high-severity findings straight back, so the agent fixes them before moving on. Runs locally, no account needed.
